title: Former Qin
capsule: The Former Qin was a Di-led dynastic state during the Sixteen Kingdoms period of 4th-century northern China. Under Fu Jian it briefly unified almost all of northern China before its catastrophic defeat at the Battle of Fei River in 383 against the Eastern Jin, after which it rapidly fragmented and collapsed by 394. It bore no political continuity with the ancient state of Qin despite sharing the name.
